tutorial: No single wiki tutorial covers the document, measure, material, inspection, OpenSCAD and Robot tools; the script follows the scripting pages instead: Robot_API_example.md (axes, Tcp, waypoints, trajectory), Document_structure.md / Object_name.md / App_Link.md / Std_LinkMake.md (names, labels, links), Inspection_Workbench.md, OpenSCAD_Workbench.md (CSG out and in), on one small part: a 40 x 30 x 20 box and a r5 x 20 cylinder.

robot.from: worked out here from the Denavit-Hartenberg table in FreeCAD 1.1 source: src/Mod/Robot/App/Robot6Axis.cpp — not run

conventions: "<YPR>" stands for the tcp.ypr list answered by the robot_move { axes } call: put that list in its place. Face and edge numbers of a Part::Box / Part::Cylinder are stated as FreeCAD usually numbers them (Box: Face1 x-min, Face2 x-max, Face5 z-min, Face6 z-max); where an expect says so, take the ref from the shape_query before it instead.

notCovered: object_freeze { objects }: freezing needs the window (Std_ToggleFreeze); it is in coredoc-gui-model.json. skipRecompute is covered here.
link_edit import / import_all: need a link into a second open document; make one by hand (two documents, a link across) if wanted.
import_file of DXF, SVG, mesh and image files: no such file is made by this script (export { format: stl } then import_file covers the mesh path in tests/test_doc.py).
insp_run { file }: needs a scan file on disk.
scad_code and scad_op minkowski need the OpenSCAD program: the calls are here, refused as unavailable without it.
robot_new { kinematics } and the KUKA model files: this FreeCAD may ship none (the reply's model says which robot was made).
material_set through an add-on's material_set service (marked from): only with that add-on installed.
doc_close of a document whose label two documents share: tests/test_doc.py covers it (it needs a label set to a duplicate, which no tool does).
